from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class FinancingActivityRecord(BaseModel):
    """A financing cash flow line item extracted from a single company's document."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the company that filed this document")
    line_item_label: str | None = Field(description="The specific text of the line item (e.g. 'Net cash used in financing activities')")
    amount: float | None = Field(description="The signed numeric amount; negative indicates cash outflow/usage, positive indicates inflow")
    period_end: str | None = Field(description="The end date of the reporting period for this amount (e.g. 'March 31, 2024')")
    currency: str | None = Field(description="The currency of the amount, e.g. USD")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    financing_activities: list[FinancingActivityRecord]
